settings.custom_css:
selector { height: 100%; transition: background-color .15s; }
selector:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6B5BD6; outline-offset: 3px; }

selector { font: 700 48px/1 Montserrat, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #231B2B; }
selector .maloka-rango { font-size: 0.75em; }
selector { font: 600 16px/1.2 Montserrat, sans-serif; color: #231B2B; text-transform: lowercase; }

settings.title: Tipo
settings.custom_css:
selector { align-self: flex-start; }
selector .elementor-heading-title { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; background: #B4A5F5; white-space: nowrap; }

settings.title: Título del evento
settings.custom_css:
selector a { color: inherit; }
selector a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
